parallels.note: Pilate said to them, “Why, what evil has he done?” But they cried out exceedingly, “Crucify him!”

translations.web: But the governor said, “Why? What evil has he done?” But they cried out exceedingly, saying, “Let him be crucified!”
translations.bsb: “Why?” asked Pilate. “What evil has He done?” But they shouted all the louder, “Crucify Him!”
translations.kjv: And the governor said, Why, what evil hath he done? But they cried out the more, saying, Let him be crucified.
translations.asv: And he said, Why, what evil hath he done? But they cried out exceedingly, saying, Let him be crucified.
